_comment: A DB reporting agent: postgres (read-only query) + brave-search (untrusted web) + slack (post). Tool names from the archived server READMEs. Postgres runs in a READ ONLY transaction, so it reads PRIVATE data; the trifecta still closes because untrusted search results can steer the Slack post.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the database

tools.name: brave_web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return results

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel
